draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.40, the 20th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 5th of 28 at WR. He went 8th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Ed McCaffrey. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,084 receiving yards in 2021, 12th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons. 62 career games and 60 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 8 AV in 2025 against a career-best 10 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: drop rate 0.9% (94th percentile), receiving td 7 (89th percentile), team target share 21.6% (88th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 wide receiver who played: 919 receiving yards against a median of 302, above the norm.
